criteria.name: Text Type
criteria.feedback: Your essay is organized into multiple paragraphs with topic sentences and a clear introduction, but it would benefit from stronger transitions and more obvious connections between your ideas to create smoother overall flow.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.feedback: Your essay gives clear reasons and examples about why Santiago is appealing for young people, but to score higher, you need to propose a specific city improvement and discuss its immediate and long-term effects as the prompt requests.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Your writing is mostly understandable, but frequent errors in grammar, word choice, and verb tenses make your meaning unclear at times. Focusing on sentence structure, subject-verb agreement, and word forms will help you communicate more clearly.
